sources.entry: Canvas LMS - Learning management system (LMS) that is revolutionizing the way we educate. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Ruby

summary.one_liner: Canvas LMS is an open-source learning management system developed and maintained by Instructure Inc., released under AGPLv3.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and describes Canvas as a modern, open-source LMS maintained by Instructure Inc. It states the project is released under the AGPLv3 license for use by anyone interested in learning management systems. Detailed installation and configuration instructions are not in the README and are instead kept on the project wiki, which has Quick Start and Production Start sections. The README itself does not list features, supported platforms, or integrations. The metadata places it in the 'Learning and Courses' section of awesome-selfhosted and identifies Ruby as the primary language.
use_cases: run a learning management system for courses
host an open-source LMS for a school
evaluate an open-source alternative to commercial LMS platforms
how_to_run: See the project wiki for Quick Start instructions
See the project wiki for Production Start instructions
notable: Open-source LMS developed and maintained by Instructure Inc.
Installation documentation hosted on a separate wiki with Quick Start and Production Start guides
caveats: README is minimal; installation details are only on the external wiki
Setup complexity is not described in the README
